quote: Under President Trump, the U.S. became the Number One Producer of Oil and Natural Gas in the World — and we will soon be again by lifting restrictions on American Energy Production and terminating the Socialist Green New Deal.

sourceTitle.en: 2024 Republican Party Platform, “Make America Great Again!” (PDF, undated; adopted by the RNC Platform Committee July 8, 2024, per the GOP press release of that date), p. 11

summary.en: The platform says Republicans will lift restrictions on American energy production and terminate the Green New Deal.
